rat_son_salt_gse65663.summary: Selected salt-loading effects compared against the published Table S1
rat_son_salt_gse65663.note: Greenwood et al., Table S1. The 9,843 salt-versus-euhydrated probe sets all have reported BH-adjusted P < 0.05. S1 omits probes outside this selected list. GSE65663, male Sprague-Dawley rat bulk supraoptic nucleus. The ten GSMs match the registered sample sheet by accession and source title. Each of the five arrays per group measures an independent RNA pool of five rats. Individual pool membership is unavailable. Seven days of 2% saline in place of drinking water minus euhydrated control. The S1 group means and signed Log FC confirm SL minus EU. Water deprivation is a separate GSE3110 experiment. Among 3,564 matched genes, 3,079 use the published single-probe log2 effect and 485 use the equal-weight mean of all constituent S1 log2 effects. Averaging group differences matches the registered pre-fit log-scale probe average. All 3,564 have the same nonzero sign. Pearson r and Spearman rho both round to 1.000000. The median absolute log2 difference is 3.39e-08. The pairs cover 3,564/5,719 (62.32%) of the selected single-Entrez reference and 3,564/14,604 (24.40%) of registered genes. The selected reference falls below the 90% v2 coverage requirement. GeneSpring used unmoderated Welch tests with BH correction per probe. The registered limma analysis uses moderated gene tests after probe aggregation. Both raw and adjusted P are present on all S1 rows. Among 3,079 comparable single-probe tests, 3,079 author and 2,997 registered results pass BH < 0.05. For the 485 multi-probe effect pairs, S1 supplies no combined gene P or FDR. The primary comparison, extraction and complementary Johnson et al. analysis are retained in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE65663/codex-2026-11-21. A separate replay of unpaired, two-sided Welch tests on the 31,099 deposited probes, with BH across all 31,099, recovers exactly the 9,843 S1 probe IDs at adjusted P < 0.05. The maximum absolute differences from S1 are 1.48e-7 or less for raw P and 3.89e-7 or less for adjusted P. Values outside S1 come from this reconstruction. The registered limma BH family comprises 24,482 fitted rows after aggregation, including 9,878 unpublished rows without gene symbols. Of the 6,192 published registered genes with BH < 0.05, 2,997 also meet the author cutoff on a comparable single probe. Of the remaining 3,195, 1,091 have no mapped S1 probe, 1,676 have a mapped S1 probe but no eligible effect pair, and 428 have a paired multi-probe effect without an author gene-level test.
